name: Tumelo Kovalenko-Mazurek
role: Chemical and biological agent specialist — poisoner
location: Crucible Square — open-air market, Tier 1-2 commerce, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Tumelo Kovalenko-Mazurek is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 38, his face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and he has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, he worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. He works as a poisoner out of Crucible Square, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Tumelo Kovalenko-Mazurek is known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
psychology.secret: Suki Sorokin-Gyasi has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
example_lines: "The best poison is the one nobody tests for."
"Patience, precision, and an understanding of human biology. Everything else is optional."

story_hooks: The fixer who handles Suki Sorokin-Gyasi's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
A crew member from Suki Sorokin-Gyasi's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A corporate black site Suki Sorokin-Gyasi once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
narrative_function: As a poisoner, Suki Sorokin-Gyasi embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation. Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: True cosmopolitan blend of Eastern European (36.1%), Sub-Saharan African (35.5%), Southeast Asian (16.7%), Hispanic/Latin American (7.4%), and South Asian (4.3%) ancestry. The genetic mix creates a distinctively balanced facial geometry — sharp cheekbones and angular jaw from Eastern European lineage, modulated by the warmer, fuller contours of Sub-Saharan African and Southeast Asian features. High cheekbones with moderate projection, warm mid-tone undertones that reflect the equal weight of African and Eastern European genetics, layered with subtle Southeast Asian eye shape influence and a hint of Latin warmth in the skin's natural saturation.
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground with a center of gravity designed for impact absorption. Shoulders broad relative to frame, legs powerful and coiled. No excess body fat — efficient rather than imposing.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Closely cropped, military-precise, easy to maintain between identities
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and constantly assessing
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm bronze complexion — the balanced synthesis of Eastern European and Sub-Saharan African genetics creating depth and even saturation, brightened by Southeast Asian warmth and a subtle golden undertone from Latin heritage. Not monolithic, but genuinely multicontinental in its warm-medium range.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones with moderate projection, angular jaw softened by fuller lower face contours from Sub-Saharan African and Southeast Asian genetics. Bone structure reads as authentically mixed — the Eastern European angularity tempered by rounder cheek placement and broader nasal bridge width characteristic of African and Southeast Asian ancestry. Eyes show slight epicanthic fold influence from Southeast Asian heritage. Minimal facial hair — meticulously shaved. Skin shows minor chemical scarring along the left temple (old lab accident or deliberate alteration). Otherwise clean complexion with consistent warm undertones throughout.
distinguishing_marks: Hairline scar along left temple, approximately 3cm, pale and deliberately left unaugmented
Burn scarring on inner right forearm (palm-side), small scattered marks consistent with chemical splash, deliberately left visible
Faint track marks along inside of left elbow — old habit, now replaced by implant delivery systems
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Wired reflexes substrate visible as subtle chrome threading along the neck and upper shoulders — thin lines of brushed steel running beneath the skin like tattoos. Adrenaline pump housing visible as a small raised nodule behind the right ear, approximately 2cm, darkened chrome. Fingertips and toe pads show the telltale chrome-black shimmer of gecko-grip implants when hands/feet are extended or climbing.
physical_description.posture_movement: Balanced, economical movement — no wasted motion. Stands with weight distributed forward on the balls of his feet, ready to move in any direction instantly. Hands rest naturally at his sides or in his lap, fingers slightly curled as if about to grip something. Eyes track exits and visual obstacles reflexively. When stationary, he radiates the controlled stillness of something coiled rather than relaxed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 hybrid — functional but not flashy. Dark fitted compression shirt (black or dark grey, moisture-wicking synthetic), reinforced cargo pants with multiple pockets (worn black, tactical cuts), sturdy ankle boots (steel-toed, matte finish). A lightweight jacket in neutral color (charcoal, olive, or faded black) with internal pockets — worn open most of the time. No branding visible — corporate logos removed or never present. Clothing is utilitarian, replaceable, designed for movement and concealment of equipment. The overall effect is 'unremarkable tradesperson' or 'maintenance worker' — deliberately invisible.
